This is a new role within Gargash Group Technology (GGT), created to bring the Jira platform fully under GGT governance, provide dedicated day-to-day administration and support, and unlock the platform’s value as a single, group-wide workflow backbone. The role holder will be the named technical owner of the Jira estate — responsible for platform configuration, user provisioning, workflow design, automation, integrations, vendor management, and end-user support. The role will work closely with business stakeholders across procurement, marketing, HR, sales, and after-sales to ensure Jira is configured to support real business outcomes rather than ad-hoc, fragmented usage. This is a hands-on individual contributor role within the Applications Support function. Success in this role is measured by platform stability, user satisfaction, and the demonstrable consolidation of business workflows onto a single, well-governed Jira instance. Scope of Platform Atlassian Jira Software, Jira Service Management, and Confluence — cloud and any retained on-premise components. All Jira projects across business units, including procurement and tendering workflows, marketing demand intake, HR processes, pre-delivery inspection (PDI), after-sales workflows, and brand-specific service-management instances. Marketplace apps, plugins, and integrations — including Power BI reporting connectors, single sign-on (SSO) integration with the group identity provider, and any approved third-party automation tools. The direct vendor relationship with Atlassian following the planned re-papering of the contract away from the previous reseller channel. Key Responsibilities Platform Administration Own day-to-day administration of the Jira and Confluence estate — user provisioning and deprovisioning, permission schemes, project configuration, workflow design, screen schemes, custom fields, and notification schemes. Maintain platform hygiene — retire unused projects, archive stale data, consolidate duplicate workflows, and keep the global configuration set defensibly small. Design and maintain Jira automation rules to reduce manual effort and enforce process discipline. Manage marketplace apps and integrations, including security review, licensing, version upgrades, and decommissioning of unused add-ons. Maintain Jira’s integration with Power BI and any other approved reporting layer, ensuring data flows are reliable and access is properly governed. Coordinate Atlassian product upgrades, change windows, and any cloud-migration activity in line with GGT change management standards. User Support & Service Delivery Act as Level 2 support for all Jira and Confluence-related tickets escalated from the Service Desk — triage, diagnose, resolve, and document. Maintain a knowledge base of common how-to articles, project templates, and self-service resources to reduce avoidable ticket volume. Deliver onboarding training and refresher sessions to project owners, business administrators, and power users across the group. Support business units in designing new workflows or service projects — capture requirements, propose a fit-for-purpose configuration, build, test, and hand over. Maintain a backlog of platform enhancement requests, prioritised against business value and operational risk. Governance, Security & Licensing Maintain the authoritative inventory of Jira projects, owners, user counts, and license consumption — published to GGT leadership on a regular cadence. Run periodic access reviews with project owners to remove dormant users, retire orphaned projects, and right-size licence allocation. Ensure all Jira configuration changes follow GGT change-management standards, with appropriate approval, testing, and rollback paths. Support the Cybersecurity function on platform security posture — SSO enforcement, MFA, audit logging, data residency, and any vulnerability findings. Own the operational relationship with Atlassian — raise and track support cases, manage renewal data, and coordinate with Procurement on the annual contract cycle. Workflow Consolidation & Group Value Work with business stakeholders — procurement, marketing, HR, sales, after-sales — to identify opportunities where existing manual or shadow-IT workflows can be consolidated onto Jira. Bring discipline and consistency to how workflows are designed across business units, while respecting genuine differences in operating model. Avoid over-engineering — the platform should solve real business problems with the simplest configuration that works, not the most elaborate one. Support the Head of Applications and Group Head of Technology on any future strategic review of the Jira platform, including alternative or complementary tooling assessments. Person Specification Essential Requirements Minimum 5 years of hands-on experience administering Atlassian Jira and Confluence in a multi-team or multi-business-unit environment. Experience administering Jira Service Management (incident, request, change) and configuring service projects for business teams. Working knowledge of Atlassian Cloud administration, identity integration (SSO/SCIM), and marketplace app governance. Proven track record providing Level 2 application support — ticket triage, root-cause investigation, user-facing resolution, and clear written communication. Experience working with reporting and analytics layers (Power BI, Tableau, or equivalent) connected to Jira data. Strong written and verbal communication skills in English. Desirable Requirements Atlassian Certified Professional credentials (ACP-100, ACP-120, or equivalent). ITIL Foundation certification or equivalent service-management grounding. Experience in automotive, retail, or diversified conglomerate environments. Previous experience in the UAE / GCC region. Familiarity with procurement, demand-management, or PMO workflows. Key Responsibilities: * Handle day-to-day corporate and commercial legal matters. * Draft, review, and negotiate commercial agreements, supplier agreements, distribution agreements, leases, NDAs, and other contracts. * Provide legal advice to the business on commercial transactions and operational matters. * Handle and follow up on corporate disputes and litigation in coordination with external counsel when required. * Manage and follow up on licenses, permits, and regulatory requirements related to retail branches and business operations. * Support the legal requirements related to opening and operating new branches. * Review and advise on import, distribution, and trading-related legal matters. * Ensure compliance with applicable laws and regulations affecting the company’s retail and distribution activities. * Review agreements with suppliers, customers, landlords, service providers, and other business partners. * Coordinate with government authorities, external lawyers, and relevant internal departments when required. * Identify potential legal risks and provide practical recommendations to the business. * Maintain and organize corporate legal documents, contracts, licenses, and other legal records. Requirements: * Bachelor’s degree in Law. * 3–5 years of relevant experience in Corporate & Commercial Law. * Strong experience in corporate and commercial contracts. * Experience in corporate disputes and litigation is preferred. * Previous experience in retail, distribution, trading, or FMCG/electronics companies is highly preferred. * Good knowledge of retail licensing, permits, and regulatory procedures. * Experience dealing with government authorities and regulatory bodies. * Strong negotiation, drafting, and communication skills. * Business-oriented mindset with the ability to provide practical legal solutions. * Excellent command of English and Arabic.

review_candidates.description: Descripción En Userbrain, siempre estamos buscando personas que puedan ayudarnos a mejorar la experiencia de usuario de sitios web, prototipos y aplicaciones móviles. Como Userbrain Tester, desempeñarás un papel crucial en la investigación de usuarios de nuestros clientes, proporcionando valiosos comentarios sobre diversos productos digitales. Esta es una oportunidad única para ganar dinero desde casa, en tu propio horario, sin necesidad de experiencia específica. Acerca del puesto Localización: Remoto (en todo el mundo) 🌎 Remuneración: $5 por prueba completada 💸 ¿Cómo funciona? Regístrate y descarga nuestra Grabadora Userbrain para Google Chrome, iOS o Android para empezar a probar sitios web. Di lo que piensas mientras realizas una serie de tareas durante unos 5 a 20 minutos. Recibe nuevas pruebas y cobra $5 por prueba a través de PayPal. ¿Qué ocurre después de presentar la solicitud? Se te pedirá que grabes una Prueba de Calificación. No te preocupes, primero te daremos un tour y una guía, para que sepas exactamente cómo funciona todo. Después revisaremos tu vídeo y te daremos feedback sobre cómo y qué podrías mejorar en futuras pruebas. Empezarás a recibir tests de pago si eres aprobado como tester de Userbrain. Requisitos Disponer de una conexión a Internet fiable y de un dispositivo para realizar las pruebas (ordenador, smartphone o tableta). Hablar Español con fluidez. Puedes articular tus pensamientos con claridad y proporcionar comentarios constructivos. Sobre el proceso de solicitud Recibimos tu solicitud Realizas una Prueba de Calificación Revisamos tu prueba y te proporcionamos comentarios Si se aprueba, empezarás a recibir pruebas remuneradas Conviértete en Tester de Userbrain
